description: This file generates Python bindings for ATen functions in PyTorch, including methods, dispatch code, and return type handling. It manages code generation for various function signatures, overloads, and modules like torch, torch.nn, torch.fft, etc.

classes.name: PythonSignature
classes.description: Represents a Python function signature for code generation.

classes.name: PythonSignatureDeprecated
classes.description: Represents a deprecated Python function signature.

classes.name: PythonSignatureGroup
classes.description: Groups overloads of a function signature for code generation.

classes.name: PythonSignatureNativeFunctionPair
classes.description: Pairs a function signature with a native function.

classes.name: PythonSignatureVariable
classes.description: Represents a variable in a Python signature.

methods.name: should_generate_py_binding
methods.description: Determines if a native function should have Python bindings generated.

methods.name: get_pycname
methods.description: Generates the C name for Python variable binding.

methods.name: is_noarg
methods.description: Checks if overloads have no arguments.

methods.name: is_py_variable_method
methods.description: Checks if a function is a Python variable method.

methods.name: is_py_torch_function
methods.description: Checks if a function is a torch function.

methods.name: is_py_nn_function
methods.description: Checks if a function is a torch.nn function.

methods.name: is_py_fft_function
methods.description: Checks if a function is a torch.fft function.

methods.name: is_py_linalg_function
methods.description: Checks if a function is a torch.linalg function.

methods.name: is_py_nested_function
methods.description: Checks if a function is a torch.nested function.

methods.name: is_py_sparse_function
methods.description: Checks if a function is a torch.sparse function.

methods.name: is_py_special_function
methods.description: Checks if a function is a torch.special function.

methods.name: gen
methods.description: Main entry point to generate Python bindings and related code.

methods.name: group_filter_overloads
methods.description: Groups overloads of functions based on a predicate.

methods.name: create_python_bindings
methods.description: Generates Python binding code for a set of functions.

methods.name: create_python_return_type_bindings
methods.description: Generates code for functions returning named tuples.

methods.name: create_python_return_type_bindings_header
methods.description: Generates header declarations for return type functions.

methods.name: create_python_bindings_sharded
methods.description: Generates sharded Python binding code for large sets of functions.

methods.name: load_signatures
methods.description: Loads function signatures, including deprecated ones.

methods.name: load_deprecated_signatures
methods.description: Loads deprecated function signatures and matches them to current signatures.

methods.name: sort_overloads
methods.description: Sorts overloads based on a partial order to resolve ambiguity.

methods.name: emit_single_dispatch
methods.description: Generates dispatch code for a single native function.

methods.name: method_impl
methods.description: Generates Python binding code for a function overload.

methods.name: forward_decls
methods.description: Generates forward declaration code for functions.

methods.name: method_def
methods.description: Generates method definition entries for Python bindings.
